  data_dir: "../data/synthetic"

  undated_dose_rule: "unknown"   # "unknown" (SAP v2.1: cause 2) or "visit_date"

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, comment = "")
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(readr); library(stringr); library(purrr)
  library(lubridate); library(knitr)
})
source(params$functions)
dir.create(params$out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
launch <- study_dates$launch
kbl <- function(x, ...) knitr::kable(x, format.args = list(big.mark = ","), ...)
```

> **Blinding note.** This document reports data-quality and completeness
> checks only. It never tabulates vaccination outcomes by arm. Outcome
> comparisons are made only in `02_prespecified_analysis.Rmd`, after the
> eligibility review has been frozen and the dataset locked (SAP).

# Load the CHT extracts

```{r load}
path <- function(f) file.path(params$data_dir, f)
files <- list(
  Mali = list(patients = params$mali_patients, baseline = params$mali_baseline,
              followup = params$mali_followup, verification = params$mali_verification),
  CIV  = list(patients = params$civ_patients, baseline = params$civ_baseline,
              followup = params$civ_followup, verification = params$civ_verification))
raw <- map(files, ~ map(.x, ~ read_table(path(.x))))

tibble(country = rep(names(files), each = 4),
       table   = rep(names(files$Mali), 2),
       file    = unlist(map(files, unlist)),
       found   = unlist(map(raw, ~ map_lgl(.x, Negate(is.null)))),
       rows    = unlist(map(raw, ~ map_int(.x, ~ if (is.null(.x)) NA_integer_ else nrow(.x)))),
       columns = unlist(map(raw, ~ map_int(.x, ~ if (is.null(.x)) NA_integer_ else ncol(.x))))) %>% kbl()

countries <- names(raw)[map_lgl(raw, ~ !is.null(.x$patients))]
if (!length(countries)) stop("No patients table found: check params$data_dir and the file names.")
missing_tbl <- setdiff(names(raw), countries)
if (length(missing_tbl)) warning("No patients table for: ", paste(missing_tbl, collapse = ", "),
                                 " - this country is skipped.")
```

# Master list of girls (patients table)

Arm comes from `vaccination_trial_branch`; date of birth from `date_of_birth`,
completed by `etl_dob_combine`; site and CHW supervision zone from `site_uuid`
and `supervisor_area_uuid` (SAP v2.5 field mapping). Names and phone numbers are never read
into the analysis dataset.

```{r patients}
girls0 <- map_dfr(countries, function(cn) {
  p <- raw[[cn]]$patients
  dob_raw <- to_date(col_or_na(p, "date_of_birth"))
  tibble(
    country      = cn,
    girl_id      = p$uuid,
    arm          = norm_arm(col_or_na(p, "vaccination_trial_branch")),
    in_trial     = to_bool(col_or_na(p, "in_vaccination_trial")),
    sex          = norm_sex(coalesce(col_or_na(p, "etl_sex"), col_or_na(p, "sexe"))),
    dob          = coalesce(dob_raw, to_date(col_or_na(p, "etl_dob_combine"))),
    dob_source   = case_when(!is.na(dob_raw) ~ "date_of_birth",
                             !is.na(to_date(col_or_na(p, "etl_dob_combine"))) ~ "etl_dob_combine",
                             TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    dob_approx   = !is.na(to_date(col_or_na(p, "etl_dob_approx"))) | is.na(dob_raw),
    site         = coalesce(col_or_na(p, "site_name"), col_or_na(p, "site_uuid")),
    chw_zone     = col_or_na(p, "supervisor_area_uuid"),
    muted_date   = to_date(col_or_na(p, "muted")),
    death_date   = to_date(col_or_na(p, "date_of_death")),
    family_muted_date = to_date(col_or_na(p, "c50_family_muted")))
})

# Duplicate master records
dups <- girls0 %>% count(country, girl_id) %>% filter(n > 1)
girls0 <- girls0 %>% distinct(country, girl_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Trial membership: an arm is recorded
girls0 %>% mutate(arm_recorded = !is.na(arm)) %>%
  count(country, in_vaccination_trial = in_trial, arm_recorded) %>% kbl(caption = "Trial flags in the master table")
girls <- girls0 %>% filter(!is.na(arm))
cat("Duplicate patient uuids removed:", nrow(dups), "\n")
```

# Assessment records from the three forms

One row per form submission, with HPV status (`yes`/`no`/unknown), the
documented vaccination date, and the reasons why status could not be obtained.

```{r records}
no_info <- trimws(strsplit(params$followup_no_info_values, ",")[[1]])
rec_raw <- map_dfr(countries, function(cn) bind_rows(
  records_baseline(raw[[cn]]$baseline, cn),
  records_followup(raw[[cn]]$followup, cn, no_info_values = no_info),
  records_verification(raw[[cn]]$verification, cn)))

# Same submission exported twice -> keep once
rec_raw <- rec_raw %>% distinct(country, record_uuid, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Forms for girls not in the trial master list
orphans <- rec_raw %>% anti_join(girls, by = c("country", "girl_id")) %>% count(country, form)
rec <- clean_records(rec_raw %>% semi_join(girls, by = c("country", "girl_id")), launch)

qc_rec <- rec_raw %>% semi_join(girls, by = c("country", "girl_id")) %>%
  mutate(launch = launch[country],
         assess_missing = is.na(assess_date),
         assess_outside = !is.na(assess_date) & (assess_date < launch - 30 | assess_date > study_dates$window_end),
         assess_before_launch = !is.na(assess_date) & assess_date < launch & assess_date >= launch - 30,
         vacc_after_visit = !is.na(vacc_date) & !is.na(assess_date) & vacc_date > assess_date,
         dose_undated = hpv %in% "yes" & is.na(vacc_date),
         status_missing = is.na(hpv)) %>%
  group_by(country, form) %>%
  summarise(records = n(), girls = n_distinct(girl_id),
            `no assessment date (dropped)` = sum(assess_missing),
            `assessment date out of window (dropped)` = sum(assess_outside),
            `visit up to 30 days before launch (kept)` = sum(assess_before_launch),
            `dose dated after the visit (date set to missing)` = sum(vacc_after_visit),
            `dose reported without a date` = sum(dose_undated),
            `HPV status not obtained` = sum(status_missing), .groups = "drop")
kbl(qc_rec, caption = "Record-level data quality (all arms pooled)")
if (nrow(orphans)) kbl(orphans, caption = "Form records for girls absent from the master list (excluded)")

# Duplicate baseline forms per girl
rec %>% filter(form == "baseline") %>% count(country, girl_id) %>% filter(n > 1) %>%
  count(country, name = "girls with >1 baseline form") %>% kbl()
```

## Fill zone and date of birth from the forms when absent from the master list

```{r fill}
form_zone <- rec %>% filter(!is.na(chw_zone_form)) %>% count(country, girl_id, chw_zone_form) %>%
  group_by(country, girl_id) %>% slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  select(country, girl_id, zone_from_form = chw_zone_form)
form_dob <- rec %>% filter(!is.na(age_days_form), age_days_form > 0) %>%
  mutate(dob_f = assess_date - age_days_form) %>% group_by(country, girl_id) %>%
  summarise(dob_from_form = as.Date(median(as.numeric(dob_f)), origin = "1970-01-01"), .groups = "drop")

girls <- girls %>% left_join(form_zone, by = c("country", "girl_id")) %>%
  left_join(form_dob, by = c("country", "girl_id")) %>%
  mutate(zone_source = if_else(is.na(chw_zone) & !is.na(zone_from_form), "form", "patients"),
         chw_zone = coalesce(chw_zone, zone_from_form),
         dob_source = if_else(is.na(dob) & !is.na(dob_from_form), "form age_in_days", dob_source),
         dob_approx = dob_approx | (is.na(dob) & !is.na(dob_from_form)),
         dob = coalesce(dob, dob_from_form)) %>%
  select(-zone_from_form, -dob_from_form)
girls %>% count(country, dob_source, zone_source) %>% kbl(caption = "Source of date of birth and CHW zone")
```

# Allocation by the age-out rule and age covariates

The age-out allocation is not recorded in CHT. It is taken from the **allocation
lists** made at randomization (24 March 2026): one file per country with the
girls allocated to the intervention arm by the age-out rule (`mali_ageout`,
`civ_ageout`). If a country's list is absent, the allocation is recovered from
the current date of birth instead: intervention-arm girls reaching the national
upper age limit between 1 April and 1 July 2026 (`ageout_window_start`,
`ageout_window_end`). The date-of-birth rule is also shown next to the list, as
a check of how well current dates of birth agree with those used at allocation.

```{r ageout}
girls <- girls %>%
  mutate(launch          = launch[country],
         lower           = map_dbl(country, ~ eligibility[[.x]][["lower"]]),
         upper           = map_dbl(country, ~ eligibility[[.x]][["upper"]]),
         ageout_date     = add_years(dob, upper),
         eligible_from   = add_years(dob, lower),
         age_launch_days = as.numeric(launch - dob),
         age_years       = floor(time_length(interval(dob, launch), "years")),
         months_remaining = as.numeric(ageout_date - launch) / 30.4375,
         ageout_rule     = !is.na(ageout_date) & ageout_date >= as.Date(params$ageout_window_start) &
                           ageout_date <= as.Date(params$ageout_window_end))

# Allocation lists (source of truth when available)
ao_files <- c(Mali = params$mali_ageout, CIV = params$civ_ageout)
ao_list <- map_dfr(countries, function(cn) {
  f <- ao_files[[cn]]
  d <- if (is.null(f) || is.na(f) || !nzchar(f)) NULL else read_table(path(f))
  if (is.null(d)) return(tibble())
  tibble(country = cn, girl_id = as.character(d$c50_patient_uuid),
         ao_group = as.character(col_or_na(d, "ao_group")))
}) %>% distinct(country, girl_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
list_countries <- unique(ao_list$country)
girls <- girls %>%
  left_join(ao_list %>% mutate(in_ageout_list = TRUE), by = c("country", "girl_id")) %>%
  mutate(in_ageout_list = coalesce(in_ageout_list, FALSE),
         ageout_source = if_else(country %in% list_countries, "allocation list", "date of birth"),
         ageout = if_else(country %in% list_countries, in_ageout_list & arm == "Intervention",
                          ageout_rule & arm == "Intervention"),
         ageout_list_control = in_ageout_list & arm == "Control",
         ageout_rule_control = ageout_rule & arm == "Control",
         allocation = if_else(ageout, "Age-out rule", "Randomized"))

girls %>% group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(source = first(ageout_source),
            intervention = sum(arm == "Intervention"), control = sum(arm == "Control"),
            `age-out (analysis)` = sum(ageout),
            `listed girls in control arm` = sum(ageout_list_control),
            `missing DOB` = sum(is.na(dob)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(`age-out expected` = expected_ageout[country],
         `difference` = `age-out (analysis)` - `age-out expected`) %>%
  kbl(caption = "Age-out allocation vs known totals (Mali 1,945; CIV 165)")
```

```{r ageout_list_checks, eval = nrow(ao_list) > 0}
# Listed girls not found among trial girls in the master table
ao_list %>% anti_join(girls, by = c("country", "girl_id")) %>% count(country, name = "listed girls not in master table") %>%
  kbl(caption = "Allocation list: girls missing from the patients table")
ao_list %>% count(country, ao_group) %>% kbl(caption = "Allocation list: ao_group values")
# Agreement between the list and the date-of-birth rule (intervention arm)
girls %>% filter(arm == "Intervention", country %in% list_countries) %>%
  count(country, `in allocation list` = in_ageout_list, `meets DOB rule` = ageout_rule) %>%
  kbl(caption = "Allocation list vs date-of-birth rule, intervention arm")
```

```{r ageout_periods}

# Date each girl reaches the upper age limit, by arm (no outcomes)
rand_date <- as.Date(params$randomization_date)
girls %>% mutate(ageout_period = case_when(
    is.na(ageout_date) ~ "DOB missing",
    ageout_date < rand_date ~ "1. before randomization (ineligible)",
    ageout_date < as.Date(params$ageout_window_start) ~ "2. randomization to window start",
    ageout_date < launch ~ "3. window start to launch",
    ageout_date <= as.Date(params$ageout_window_end) ~ "4. launch to window end",
    TRUE ~ "5. after window end")) %>%
  count(country, arm, ageout_period) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  kbl(caption = "When girls reach the upper age limit (periods 3 and 4 form the age-out allocation window)")
```

Any difference from the known totals, and any control-arm girl meeting the rule,
is investigated as a likely date-of-birth correction made after randomization.

# Post-randomization eligibility review (cause 3b)

Rule: not eligible if the current sex is male, or if the current date of birth
places the girl outside the national eligibility range for the whole study
period: already past the upper limit **at randomization (24 March 2026)**, or
not reaching the lower limit by 1 October 2026. A girl who reached the upper
limit between randomization and launch was eligible when allocated and stays in
the analysis. As specified in the SAP, the age criterion is reviewed for
randomized girls only: girls on the age-out allocation list were allocated
because they were about to age out, so they are not excluded on age. The review list below contains **no arm and no
outcome**, so it can be checked by a blinded data manager and frozen before the
analysis.

```{r eligibility}
girls <- girls %>%
  mutate(inelig_sex = sex %in% "male",
         inelig_age = !ageout & !is.na(dob) & (ageout_date <= as.Date(params$randomization_date) |
                                               eligible_from > study_dates$window_end),
         eligible_final = as.integer(!(inelig_sex | inelig_age)),
         review_reason = case_when(inelig_sex & inelig_age ~ "sex and age",
                                   inelig_sex ~ "sex", inelig_age ~ "age"),
         review_flag_missing = is.na(dob) | is.na(sex))
review_list <- girls %>% filter(eligible_final == 0 | review_flag_missing) %>%
  transmute(country, girl_id, dob, sex, review_reason,
            note = if_else(review_flag_missing, "DOB or sex missing: retained, check", NA_character_))
write_csv(review_list, file.path(params$out_dir, sprintf("eligibility_review_list_%s.csv", Sys.Date())))
girls %>% count(country, review_reason) %>% kbl(caption = "Eligibility review (NA = eligible)")
```

# Vaccination status

* **Phase 1 (status on 1 July 2026)**: vaccinated if any form records a dose
  dated on or before 1 July; known unvaccinated if an assessment dated 2 July – 1
  October records no dose or a dose dated after 1 July. A dose reported without
  a documented date gives unknown status, cause 2 (registered SAP v2.1). With
  `undated_dose_rule = "visit_date"`, a dose reported without a date at a visit
  on or before 1 July counts as vaccinated by that visit (sensitivity).
* **Verification-timing sensitivity**: the same, using only assessments up to 30
  August 2026.
* **Phase 2 (status on 1 October 2026)**: vaccinated if a dose is dated on or
  before 1 October; unvaccinated if the last visit on or before 1 October
  recorded no dose.
* **prior_vacc**: 1 if a dose is dated before launch; 0 if a form records the
  girl unvaccinated at or after launch (or at the baseline visit) or a first
  dose dated on or after launch; otherwise unknown.

```{r status}
undated_counts <- identical(params$undated_dose_rule, "visit_date")
p1  <- status_at(rec, study_dates$phase1_end, known_from = study_dates$crossover,
                 undated_counts = undated_counts)
p1a <- status_at(rec, study_dates$phase1_end, known_from = study_dates$crossover,
                 window_end = study_dates$verif_close_1, undated_counts = undated_counts)
p2  <- status_at(rec, study_dates$window_end, known_from = launch, undated_counts = undated_counts)
# Sensitivity: phase 2 status established only by a visit on/after 2 July
p2r <- status_at(rec, study_dates$window_end, known_from = study_dates$crossover,
                 undated_counts = undated_counts)
# Verification visit for phase 1: first assessment with a recorded status in 2 July - 1 October
win_visit <- rec %>% filter(!is.na(hpv), assess_date >= study_dates$crossover,
                            assess_date <= study_dates$window_end) %>%
  group_by(country, girl_id) %>% summarise(first_window_visit = min(assess_date), .groups = "drop")

prior <- rec %>% mutate(launch = launch[country]) %>% group_by(country, girl_id) %>%
  summarise(dose_before = any(hpv %in% "yes" & !is.na(vacc_date) & vacc_date < launch),
            unvacc_at_launch = any(hpv %in% "no" & (assess_date >= launch | form == "baseline")) |
                               any(hpv %in% "yes" & !is.na(vacc_date) & vacc_date >= launch),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(prior_vacc = case_when(dose_before ~ 1L, unvacc_at_launch ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_))

# Reasons why status could not be obtained (any form)
reasons <- rec %>% group_by(country, girl_id) %>%
  summarise(any_no_card = any(no_card & is.na(hpv)),
            any_info_unavailable = any(info_unavailable),
            any_refused = any(info_refused), any_moved = any(moved),
            first_visit = min(assess_date), .groups = "drop")
visits_in <- function(from, to) rec %>% filter(assess_date >= from, assess_date <= to) %>%
  distinct(country, girl_id) %>% mutate(v = TRUE)

pick <- function(s, sfx) s %>% select(country, girl_id, vacc, status_date, last_unvacc, first_dose,
                                      undated_by, undated_after, conflict, n_contacts, last_visit) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, sfx), -c(country, girl_id))
girls <- girls %>%
  left_join(pick(p1, "_p1"), by = c("country", "girl_id")) %>%
  left_join(p1a %>% select(country, girl_id, vacc_p1_aug = vacc), by = c("country", "girl_id")) %>%
  left_join(pick(p2, "_p2"), by = c("country", "girl_id")) %>%
  left_join(p2r %>% select(country, girl_id, vacc_p2_recent = vacc), by = c("country", "girl_id")) %>%
  left_join(win_visit, by = c("country", "girl_id")) %>%
  left_join(prior %>% select(country, girl_id, prior_vacc), by = c("country", "girl_id")) %>%
  left_join(reasons, by = c("country", "girl_id")) %>%
  left_join(visits_in(study_dates$crossover, study_dates$window_end) %>% rename(visited_window_p1 = v),
            by = c("country", "girl_id")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(any_no_card, any_info_unavailable, any_refused, any_moved, visited_window_p1,
                  undated_after_p1, undated_after_p2, conflict_p1, conflict_p2), ~ coalesce(.x, FALSE)),
         n_contacts = coalesce(n_contacts_p2, 0L),
         visited_any = !is.na(last_visit_p2))
```

## Conflicting records

Records are resolved in favour of a documented dose date (SAP v2.5 field mapping). Pooled
counts, all arms together:

```{r conflicts}
girls %>% group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(`dose dated <= 1 Jul and a later 'no' record` = sum(conflict_p1),
            `dose dated <= 1 Oct and a later 'no' record` = sum(conflict_p2),
            `vaccinated only via an undated report` = sum(is.na(first_dose_p1) & !is.na(undated_by_p1)),
            .groups = "drop") %>% kbl()
```

# Cause of unknown status

Registered SAP v2.1: hierarchy 3b → 1 → 3a → 2 → 3c, with refusal by parents
counted in cause 2 (the girl was reached but her status could not be verified).
With `cause_scheme = "v2.5"`: hierarchy 3b → 1 → 4 → 3a → 2 → 3c, refusal as a
separate cause 4. Assigned without reference to vaccination outcomes.

```{r causes}
assign_cause <- function(g, vacc, window_start, window_end, visited_window) {
  deact <- (!is.na(g$muted_date) & g$muted_date <= window_end) |
           (!is.na(g$death_date) & g$death_date <= window_end) |
           (!is.na(g$family_muted_date) & g$family_muted_date <= window_end) | g$any_moved
  aged  <- !is.na(g$ageout_date) & g$ageout_date <= window_end & !visited_window
  refused_c4 <- g$any_refused & identical(params$cause_scheme, "v2.5")
  noinf <- g$any_no_card | g$any_info_unavailable | g$undated_after | g$any_refused
  case_when(!is.na(vacc)          ~ NA_character_,
            g$eligible_final == 0 ~ "3b",
            deact                 ~ "1",
            refused_c4            ~ "4",
            aged                  ~ "3a",
            noinf                 ~ "2",
            TRUE                  ~ "3c")
}
girls$undated_after <- girls$undated_after_p1
girls$unknown_reason_p1 <- assign_cause(girls, girls$vacc_p1, study_dates$crossover,
                                        study_dates$window_end, girls$visited_window_p1)
girls$undated_after <- girls$undated_after_p2
girls$unknown_reason_p2 <- assign_cause(girls, girls$vacc_p2, girls$launch,
                                        study_dates$window_end, girls$visited_any)
girls <- girls %>% select(-undated_after) %>%
  mutate(death = !is.na(death_date) & death_date <= study_dates$window_end)

cause_labels <- c("1" = "1 Deactivated, deceased or moved", "2" = "2 No information source",
                  "3a" = "3a Aged out", "3b" = "3b Age/sex data correction",
                  "3c" = "3c Not reached in time", "4" = "4 Parents refused")
girls %>% filter(eligible_final == 1) %>%
  mutate(status_known_p1 = !is.na(vacc_p1)) %>%
  group_by(country, arm) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), `status known 1 Jul` = sum(status_known_p1),
            `% unknown` = round(100 * mean(!status_known_p1), 1), .groups = "drop") %>%
  kbl(caption = "Completeness of phase 1 status by arm (attrition targets: <10% control, <20% intervention)")
girls %>% filter(!is.na(unknown_reason_p1)) %>% count(country, arm, unknown_reason_p1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = unknown_reason_p1, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  kbl(caption = "Cause of unknown phase 1 status by arm (Table 6, phase 1)")
```

# Time-to-event variables

Days since the country launch. Only girls unvaccinated at launch
(`prior_vacc = 0`) enter the time-to-event analyses. A dose reported without a
usable date is placed at the visit that reported it (an upper bound).

```{r tte}
girls <- girls %>%
  mutate(tau_p1 = as.numeric(study_dates$phase1_end - launch),
         tau_p2 = as.numeric(study_dates$window_end - launch),
         event_date_p1 = if (undated_counts) pmin(first_dose_p1, undated_by_p1, na.rm = TRUE) else first_dose_p1,
         event_date_p2 = if (undated_counts) pmin(first_dose_p2, undated_by_p2, na.rm = TRUE) else first_dose_p2,
         # Phase 1 (12 weeks): known unvaccinated -> censored at 1 July; unknown -> at last_status_date
         last_status_date = last_unvacc_p1,
         time_p1  = case_when(vacc_p1 == 1 ~ as.numeric(event_date_p1 - launch),
                              vacc_p1 == 0 ~ tau_p1,
                              TRUE ~ pmin(tau_p1, pmax(0, as.numeric(last_unvacc_p1 - launch)))),
         event_p1 = as.integer(vacc_p1 %in% 1L),
         # Phase 2 (to 1 October): unvaccinated -> censored at the last visit on/before 1 October
         cens_date_p2 = if_else(!is.na(first_dose_p2) & first_dose_p2 > study_dates$window_end,
                                study_dates$window_end, last_unvacc_p2),
         time_p2  = case_when(vacc_p2 == 1 ~ as.numeric(event_date_p2 - launch),
                              TRUE ~ pmin(tau_p2, pmax(0, as.numeric(cens_date_p2 - launch)))),
         event_p2 = as.integer(vacc_p2 %in% 1L),
         across(c(time_p1, time_p2), ~ if_else(is.na(.x), 0, .x)),
         # a dose on launch day: half a day so that it counts as an event in survival software
         time_p1 = if_else(event_p1 == 1 & time_p1 <= 0, 0.5, time_p1),
         time_p2 = if_else(event_p2 == 1 & time_p2 <= 0, 0.5, time_p2),
         days_to_vacc = if_else(vacc_p1 == 1 & prior_vacc %in% 0L, time_p1, NA_real_),
         log_days_to_vacc = log(days_to_vacc + 1),
         # SAP: date of the visit in the 2 July - 1 October window at which status was verified.
         # Girls known only from a dose documented before 1 July without a later visit have none.
         assess_date_phase1 = if_else(!is.na(vacc_p1), first_window_visit, as.Date(NA)),
         verification_lag = as.numeric(assess_date_phase1 - study_dates$phase1_end),
         verified_by_30aug = !is.na(vacc_p1_aug))
girls %>% filter(eligible_final == 1) %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(`unvaccinated at launch (enter TTE)` = sum(prior_vacc %in% 0L),
            `vaccinated before launch` = sum(prior_vacc %in% 1L),
            `prior_vacc unknown (excluded from TTE)` = sum(is.na(prior_vacc)), .groups = "drop") %>% kbl()
```

# Final analysis dataset

```{r final}
analysis <- girls %>%
  transmute(
    country = factor(country, levels = c("Mali", "CIV")), girl_id,
    arm = factor(arm, levels = c("Control", "Intervention")), arm01 = as.integer(arm == "Intervention"),
    allocation, ageout, ageout_source, in_ageout_list, ao_group, ageout_list_control, ageout_rule, ageout_rule_control, site, chw_zone, zone_source,
    sex, dob, dob_source, dob_approx, age_years, months_remaining, ageout_date,
    eligible_final, review_reason, pop_itt = eligible_final == 1,
    pop_randomized = eligible_final == 1 & !ageout,
    prior_vacc,
    HPV_vaccinated = vacc_p1, status_known_phase1 = as.integer(!is.na(vacc_p1)),
    HPV_vaccinated_aug30 = vacc_p1_aug, verified_by_30aug,
    HPV_vaccinated_phase2 = vacc_p2, status_known_phase2 = as.integer(!is.na(vacc_p2)),
    HPV_vaccinated_phase2_recent = vacc_p2_recent,
    unknown_reason = unknown_reason_p1, unknown_reason_phase2 = unknown_reason_p2,
    assess_date_phase1, verification_lag, last_status_date,
    first_dose = first_dose_p2, dose_undated = is.na(first_dose_p2) & !is.na(undated_by_p2),
    days_to_vacc, log_days_to_vacc,
    tau_p1, time_p1, event_p1, tau_p2, time_p2, event_p2,
    n_contacts, last_visit = last_visit_p2, death, death_date, muted_date, family_muted_date,
    any_no_card, any_info_unavailable, any_refused, any_moved)

saveRDS(analysis, file.path(params$out_dir, "analysis_dataset.rds"))
write_csv(analysis, file.path(params$out_dir, "analysis_dataset.csv"), na = "")
saveRDS(rec, file.path(params$out_dir, "assessment_records.rds"))   # for audit
analysis %>% count(country, arm, allocation, pop_itt) %>% kbl(caption = "Girls in the analysis dataset")
```

The dataset `analysis_dataset.rds` (one row per girl) is the only input of
`02_prespecified_analysis.Rmd`. It contains the pseudonymous CHT uuid but no
names or phone numbers.
